issues.title: Fuel capacity and tank shape are configuration-dependent
issues.details: Preliminary: 3 × 80 gallons, total 240. Production account: 3 × 50 gallons, total 150. Capacity alone does not fix shell geometry.
issues.resolution: Keep distinct preliminary and production fuel assemblies. For Rock Island blockout use production capacity as a constraint, not a scale factor applied to the preliminary tank drawing.

issues.title: Machine guns and stowage cannot be merged across configurations
issues.details: HB gives seven Hotchkiss machine guns with inconsistent enumerated positions; Jordan gives five Brownings. Ammunition totals also differ. SNL names Browning platform ammunition storage.
issues.resolution: Select armament by configuration. Preserve all alternatives and use production photographs/installation drawings before placing ball mounts.

issues.title: Carburetor change runs in both directions over time
issues.locator: Jordan pp. 29,32; SNL p. 57 and note (gx), p. 309; LIB pp. 43-60
issues.details: Jordan describes replacing Zenith with Ball & Ball during production; SNL orders Zenith substitution under O.C.M. 2344, 1 September 1922. The aircraft manual also has Claudel-Hobson H.C.7.
issues.resolution: Use Ball & Ball for a supported production representation and modified U.S. No. 52 Zenith for a later service alternative. Do not assume H.C.7 was installed in the tank.

issues.title: Electrical counts and voltages in Jordan conflict with technical catalog
issues.locator: Jordan p. 29; HB pp. 160-170; SNL pp. 14,100,123
issues.details: Jordan lists one 12-V ignition generator, two 6-V generators, two 12-V batteries and one 6-V battery. SNL lists one 8-V Delco generator, one 12-V Bijur generator, a Bijur starting motor, SYR-13 ignition battery and two STR-4 starting/lighting batteries.
issues.resolution: Do not build a circuit or physical equipment count from Jordan alone. Use HB wiring and SNL for a dated technical fit; leave historical origin of Jordan wording unresolved.

issues.title: Lower crankcase bearing counts appear reversed in one assembly
issues.locator: SNL p. 17 versus p. 58; LIB p. 17
issues.details: SNL individual entries give LQ238A long lower bearing quantity 1 and LQ240A short quantity 6; p. 58 composed-of list gives six LQ238A long and one LQ240A short. Upper halves on p. 59 and LIB front/rear bearing description support one long and six short.
issues.resolution: High-confidence proposed correction to the p. 58 association: one long and six short. Raw source edges retained; do not silently edit them.

issues.title: Road-track wheel and chain sprocket diameter must be separated
issues.details: The 23.031 value on p. 136 conflicts with the road-track wheel dimensions on p. 130 and matches its chain-sprocket diameter.
issues.resolution: Use 39.237-inch outside / 32.75-inch inside for the road-track wheel as printed on p. 130; reserve 23.031 inches for the chain sprocket. p. 136 remains an apparent label error.

issues.title: Pistons differ between aircraft, original tank and replacement
issues.details: Aircraft domed/flat pistons, LQ466A original tank piston and SH1020A replacement must not become one shape. LQ469A ring position is contradictory.
issues.resolution: Retain three configuration contexts and unresolved ring location. Tank crown/compression geometry needs exact drawing.

issues.title: Exact manufacturing piece census is unavailable from the catalog alone
issues.locator: SNL note (b), p. 308; note (gy), p. 310; note (gam), p. 310
issues.details: Some commercial subassembly internals are explicitly omitted; certain supplier products are listed only as units; the spare/accessory addendum is announced for Changes No. 1.
issues.resolution: Survey covers all preserved table rows and named supplemental objects. Unlisted internals remain scope gaps, never a claim of zero parts.

issues.title: Roller total is not 58 plus 28
issues.locator: HB p. 136; SNL p. 197 and note (gp), p. 309
issues.details: There are 58 lower rollers total, with 28 spring-equipped and 30 plain in HB. SNL note (gp) explains 58 total and 28 when assembled with flange.
issues.resolution: 58 is the inclusive lower-roller total. Do not sum nested SNL assembly quantities. Upper rollers are a separate pair.

issues.title: Sponson stowage requires gun/mount reconfiguration
issues.locator: Alden specification pp. 1-2, Figs. 1-3; GUN p. 21, Plate X; HB Plate 130
issues.details: Patent shows sponson pivoting inward; gun manual describes a distinct transport arrangement with bracket A, altered gun position and coordinated traverse.
issues.resolution: A rigid deployed gun attached to a simply rotating sponson is not a validated stowage animation. Model the transport state and test swept clearance after calibration.

issues.title: Power and reverse-speed summaries disagree
issues.details: HB gives 338 hp at 1400 rpm and two reverse speeds. Jordan says approximately 400 hp at 1400 rpm and one reverse speed; HB plates illustrate high/low reverse.
issues.resolution: Use explicit transmission mechanism evidence for kinematic blockout; retain reported ratings as source claims. Do not infer dimensional changes from the power values.

issues.title: Plate scale is not a reliable engineering scale without calibration
issues.locator: HB general arrangement and dimensional plates; SNL restored plates
issues.details: Restored, dewarped and resized figures have no new measurement authority. SNL Plate 2 aspect ratio remains uncertain.
issues.resolution: Retain original-to-derivative transforms, calibrate independent axes with printed dimensions and record residuals before accepting traced coordinates.

issues.title: Belleville spring dimensional record is physically inconsistent
issues.details: SH642B outside diameter is smaller than its inside diameter on p. 219; both thickness readings are suspect. Note (gh) permits one Thrackray washer in place of three springs but supplies no correction.
issues.resolution: No numerical correction adopted. Seek drawing or measure surviving assembly.

issues.title: Drawing references with suffix letters are not part marks
issues.details: 213A accompanies M772; 679A accompanies M280, M270, M285 and M273. A leading-numeric Ordnance reference cannot become the canonical part key.
issues.resolution: Use the British piece mark for those identities; retain drawing reference separately. This is a schema/extraction rule, not source errata.

issues.title: Gauge counts and ration boxes include unrealized future-production alternatives
issues.details: First 100 tanks use four pressure gauges versus three specified for future production; box provision likewise changes.
issues.resolution: Future production is a stated alternative, not evidence that a second production batch existed.

issues.title: Preliminary engine text imports aircraft details and contains numerical anomalies
issues.locator: HB p. 45 and p. 95; LIB pp. 12,25
issues.details: HB p. 45 describes cast-iron cylinders and 24 cams on each camshaft, while the aircraft description uses welded steel cylinders and the valve train does not support treating that count as a literal tank shaft specification. HB p. 95 expressly excludes the propeller hub from the Ordnance engine.
issues.resolution: Do not copy aircraft attachments or disputed material/cam-count statements into tank CAD. Retain documented tank identifiers and seek tank-specific cylinder and camshaft drawings.

issues.title: Advertised handbook insert is not independently identified
issues.locator: HB plate list; preserved reconstruction history; SNL Plate 2
issues.details: Earlier reconstruction work recorded 143 plates plus an insert, but no separately identified handbook insert. The present survey has 143 handbook index entries and the SNL longitudinal foldout. These are not evidence that the missing handbook insert has been recovered.
issues.resolution: Use SNL Plate 2 as a documented longitudinal-section source and keep the handbook insert as an archival search gap.
